mainEntity.name: How many Seabourn ships are there?

acceptedAnswer.text: Seabourn currently operates five ships in its fleet: Seabourn Quest, Seabourn Encore, Seabourn Ovation, Seabourn Venture and Seabourn Pursuit.

mainEntity.name: Which Seabourn ship is the newest?

acceptedAnswer.text: Seabourn Pursuit is the newest of the five ships covered in this fleet, having entered service in August 2023.

mainEntity.name: Which Seabourn ships are expedition ships?

acceptedAnswer.text: Seabourn Venture and Seabourn Pursuit are the line's purpose-built expedition ships.

mainEntity.name: Which Seabourn ships are ocean ships?

acceptedAnswer.text: Seabourn Quest, Seabourn Encore and Seabourn Ovation are the fleet's primary ocean-going luxury ships.

mainEntity.name: Which Seabourn ship is best for Antarctica?

acceptedAnswer.text: Seabourn Venture and Seabourn Pursuit are the primary ships to consider for Antarctica because they are purpose-built expedition vessels equipped for remote exploration.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between Seabourn Venture and Pursuit?

acceptedAnswer.text: They are sister expedition ships with similar core capabilities, including 24 Zodiacs, kayaks and 19-person Expedition Teams. Pursuit entered service in 2023, one year after Venture.

mainEntity.name: Are Seabourn Encore and Ovation sister ships?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Seabourn describes Ovation as the sister ship to Encore.

mainEntity.name: Which Seabourn ship is best for the Mediterranean?

acceptedAnswer.text: Quest, Encore and Ovation can all be considered for Mediterranean cruising. The best choice depends heavily on the specific itinerary, departure date, suite and port schedule.

mainEntity.name: Which Seabourn ship is best for first-time Seabourn travelers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Encore or Ovation can be attractive introductions to the contemporary Seabourn ocean experience, while Quest may appeal to travelers specifically looking for the line's classic intimate atmosphere.

mainEntity.name: Which Seabourn ship has the largest capacity?

acceptedAnswer.text: Seabourn Encore and Seabourn Ovation each accommodate approximately 600 guests, making them larger than Quest and the 264-guest expedition ships.

mainEntity.name: Do all Seabourn ships have suites?

acceptedAnswer.text: Seabourn's fleet is built around luxury suite accommodation, with oceanfront suites across its ships. Encore and Ovation specifically offer oceanfront suites with private verandas.

mainEntity.name: Do Seabourn expedition ships have balconies?

acceptedAnswer.text: Seabourn expedition ships offer luxury oceanfront accommodations, but travelers should compare the specific suite category and deck plan for the sailing they are considering.

mainEntity.name: Which Seabourn ship is best for luxury adventure travel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Seabourn Venture and Pursuit are the strongest choices for travelers who want luxury combined with expedition-style exploration.

mainEntity.name: Which Seabourn ship is best for a quiet luxury cruise?

acceptedAnswer.text: Seabourn Quest can be particularly appealing to travelers who prioritize an intimate, classic small-ship atmosphere.

mainEntity.name: Which Seabourn ship has the best dining?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no single objective winner. Encore, Ovation and Quest all offer sophisticated dining, while Venture and Pursuit combine Seabourn's culinary approach with expedition travel.

mainEntity.name: Is Seabourn Venture only an expedition ship?

acceptedAnswer.text: Venture is a purpose-built expedition ship, but Seabourn also uses it for some traditional ocean voyages depending on the deployment.
Yes. Seabourn deliberately operates small ships designed to provide a more intimate, yacht-like experience than large mainstream cruise ships.

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the best Seabourn ship?

acceptedAnswer.text: Start with your destination, then compare the ship's itinerary, suite category, amenities, sailing date and price. For remote destinations, prioritize Venture or Pursuit; for traditional ocean cruising, compare Quest, Encore and Ovation.

hero.title:
Seabourn Ships
Complete Fleet Guide
hero.subtitle: Choosing the right ship can be just as important as choosing the right itinerary.
hero.description: While Seabourn Cruises is known for its intimate, yacht-like approach to luxury cruising, the fleet is not identical. The current fleet includes five ships: Seabourn Quest, Seabourn Encore, Seabourn Ovation, Seabourn Venture and Seabourn Pursuit. The first three are ocean-going luxury ships, while Venture and Pursuit are purpose-built expedition vessels. That distinction matters. If you are planning a Mediterranean escape, you may prefer the atmosphere and amenities of Seabourn Encore or Seabourn Ovation. If your goal is Antarctica, the Arctic or the Kimberley, Seabourn Venture or Seabourn Pursuit are designed specifically for that style of exploration. This guide compares the five ships so you can understand which Seabourn ship is best for your travel style, destination and priorities.

fleet.name: Seabourn Quest
fleet.description: Seabourn Quest represents the classic evolution of Seabourn's larger small-ship design. The ship entered service in 2011 and is part of the trio of vessels that Seabourn describes as a major evolution of its small-ship concept. Seabourn highlights Quest for its dining options, including complimentary dining venues, and its intimate onboard atmosphere. Its smaller capacity creates a particularly intimate feel compared with the 600-guest Encore and Ovation. For travelers who think of Seabourn as a private yacht-style experience, Quest is an important ship to consider.
fleet.bestFor: Travelers who want the classic Seabourn experience and care more about intimacy and atmosphere than having the newest ship in the fleet.
features: Multiple dining venues including complimentary options
Caviar and other signature Seabourn experiences

fleet.name: Seabourn Encore
fleet.signature: Modern Ocean Luxury With More Space
fleet.description: Seabourn Encore represents the next generation of Seabourn's ocean fleet. The ship entered service in 2016 and carries approximately 600 guests (690 feet long, 92 feet wide). Encore was designed as an evolution of earlier Seabourn ships, adding another deck and expanded common spaces. Seabourn states that Encore has 13 categories of oceanfront suites with private verandas, with suites ranging from 251 to 1,306 square feet of interior space.
fleet.bestFor: Travelers who want a modern Seabourn ocean ship with a broader selection of onboard spaces and suite categories.
features: 600 guests across 13 oceanfront suite categories with private verandas
Expanded common areas across an additional deck
Sushi, Earth & Ocean, The Colonnade, The Patio

fleet.name: Seabourn Ovation
fleet.description: Seabourn Ovation is the sister ship to Seabourn Encore and entered service in 2018. Seabourn describes Ovation as another stage in the evolution of the small-ship concept pioneered by the brand. Because Encore and Ovation share the same general design lineage, they are among the easiest Seabourn ships to compare.
fleet.bestFor: Travelers looking for a contemporary Seabourn experience with a strong combination of luxury accommodations, dining and wellness.
features: Sister ship design sharing Encore's expanded layout
Solis, The Restaurant & dedicated Sushi restaurant
Earth & Ocean, The Colonnade & The Patio
Seabourn Square, Observation Bar & Sky Bar

fleet.name: Seabourn Venture
fleet.description: Seabourn Venture is fundamentally different from Quest, Encore and Ovation. It is a purpose-built expedition ship designed to take guests into remote environments while maintaining Seabourn's luxury service and accommodations. Venture entered service in 2022 and was built to PC6 Polar Class standards. It carries 24 Zodiacs, kayaks and a 19-person expert Expedition Team. Deployments include Antarctica, the Arctic, the Northwest Passage, Kimberley, and South Pacific.
fleet.bestFor: Luxury adventure travelers who want remote destinations without giving up sophisticated accommodations and service.
features: 264 guests built to PC6 Polar Class standards
24 Zodiacs and double sea kayaks onboard
Seabourn Square, Spa, The Club & The Restaurant
Antarctica, Arctic, Northwest Passage & Kimberley capability

fleet.name: Seabourn Pursuit
fleet.signature: The Newer Generation of Seabourn Expedition Cruising
fleet.description: Seabourn Pursuit is the second purpose-built expedition ship in the Seabourn fleet. It entered service on August 12, 2023 and was designed for remote exploration while maintaining a yacht-like luxury environment. Seabourn's current expedition deployment describes Pursuit as visiting destinations across the South Pacific, Kimberley, Antarctica, South Georgia and the Falkland Islands.

features: PC6 Polar Class hull for extreme environments

considerSteps.title: 7 Things to Consider Before Choosing a Seabourn Ship
considerSteps.subtitle: Before You Book

steps.title: Start With the Destination
steps.description: Don't choose the ship first. Choose the destination you want to experience — whether European ports or polar ice.

steps.title: Compare the Itineraries
steps.description: Two Seabourn cruises to the same region can feel completely different depending on port selection, overnight stays, sea days, departure ports, number of days and excursion opportunities.

steps.title: Decide Between Ocean and Expedition
steps.description: This is the biggest decision. Ocean means luxury cruising with fine dining, relaxation and culture. Expedition means active exploration with Zodiacs, naturalists and wildlife.

steps.title: Compare Suite Categories
steps.description: The same ship can offer dramatically different experiences depending on your suite — from classic oceanfront layouts to expansive multi-room verandas.

steps.title: Look at the Ship's Amenities
steps.description: If you care about spa, pool, dining, fitness, specialty restaurants or lounges, compare the individual ship rather than assuming every Seabourn vessel is identical.

steps.title: Consider the Ship's Age and Design
steps.description: A newer ship isn't automatically better. Some travelers prefer the classic atmosphere of Quest, while others prefer the more contemporary design of Encore or Ovation.

steps.title: Compare the Total Value
steps.description: Look beyond the cruise fare. Consider suite, dining, beverages, Wi-Fi, gratuities, excursions, transfers, airfare and pre/post-cruise hotels.

sections.heading: Our Seabourn Ship Verdict: Choose the Itinerary First, Then the Ship
paragraphs: The beauty of the Seabourn fleet is that there isn't one ship that has to work for everyone. Quest is the choice for classic Seabourn intimacy. Encore and Ovation are strong choices for travelers who want contemporary ocean cruising with more expansive onboard spaces. Venture and Pursuit are the ships to consider when the destination itself is the adventure.

For Mediterranean, European and other conventional ocean journeys, compare Quest, Encore and Ovation. For Antarctica, the Arctic, Kimberley and other remote destinations, focus on Venture and Pursuit.

Our recommendation: Choose the Seabourn itinerary first, then choose the ship and suite that make that itinerary exceptional. When two ships appear equally appealing, let the itinerary, suite and sailing date make the final decision.
